## Context / Problem
Eighteen Python modules under `tests/unit` contain 36 audited prose blocks: 26 true leading docstrings and 10 full-line comment regions. Scope was revalidated against `origin/main@9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45`. The old ranges included helpers, fixtures, constants, and assertions and split several logical comment regions; the stable IDs own only actual prose. Current source uses `verify-identity` and the `gate_context.current_code_sha` seam, which remain executable and protected.

## Approach
Edit only the stable-ID blocks below. For every owned path, retain immutable before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies, remove only an allowlisted leading `Expr(Constant(str))` that is the first statement of a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining normalized ASTs to match.

Tokenize both blobs and reject every changed inline comment or non-allowlisted full-line comment. Preserve non-docstring runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Adjacent blank-line normalization is allowed only around an edited block.

## Protected false positives
All unlisted prose and every executable/directive line are protected. This includes inline queue timestamp rationale, exact subprocess arguments, current import seams, test data, and concise unrelated docstrings in the large enrichment/doctor modules.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
- Measurement/divergence prose keeps held-out boundaries, grade distinctions, recorded regression attributes, and advisory wiring.
- Detached/doctor/engine prose keeps durable child CWD, dirty-store healing, mapping and MCP-client diagnostics, hermetic HOME injection, and subprocess proof against test-package shadowing.
- Enrichment prose keeps fairness, config-table ownership, lock reclaim/canonicalization, debounce, bounded reductions, O(1) probes, scoped markers, and counted-not-timed evidence.
- Ensure/env prose keeps bounded boot, module-binding restoration, current canonical tracker lookup, complete helper registration, and loud generator failure.
- Epic/error/eval prose keeps fail-closed provider screening, distinct insecure-URL classification, Ruff-gate teeth, strict packaged-spec coverage, all-unmet scoring, and project-criterion reverse resolution.
- All modules are direct pytest inputs. `test_ensures_late_binding_isolation.py` imports its owned sibling; the eval workflow selects `test_eval_scorers.py`; spawn/relocation, suite-isolation, and env-registry tests are path/source consumers. No target `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or pydoc consumer was found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only declared stable-ID blocks and adjacent blank lines change; normalized-AST and token/comment comparisons pass on every owned path.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains its listed current contract while removing chronology, duplication, obvious narration, or separator ornament.
- [ ] An independent reviewer posts one leaf-linked TSV row per block: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Before citations use `9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45:<path>#<stable-id>`; final citations use `<final-commit-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>`; every row records `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] All five structured verify commands pass.

## Verification
The five DD-level commands recorded on this ticket run focused pytest (including real consumers), scoped Ruff check plus format-check, comment hygiene, owned-path `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify`. They are the executable completion oracle.
